governance: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Not prospective evidence, not a ledger row, does not count toward any sample floor, and clears no blocker.
why_this_is_not_the_prospective_ledger: postgame.run refuses every one of these sealed forecasts with POSTGAME_ARTIFACT_NOT_CURRENTLY_ADMISSIBLE -- three mandatory controls say they may not COUNT toward the decision floors. That gate is correct and untouched. This audit measures how wrong the forecasts were, which is a different question from whether they are admissible as evidence.

estimands_refused_by_name.team_volume/team_off_snaps: ESTIMAND_MISMATCH_SNAP_COUNT_VS_PLAY_ROW: the forecast is of offensive snaps from snap_counts; play-by-play rows are a different quantity and include penalty-nullified no_play rows
estimands_refused_by_name.team_volume/team_dropbacks_part: ESTIMAND_MISMATCH_UPPER_BOUND: the play-by-play dropback count is an upper bound on the participation-matched quantity forecast, not the quantity itself
estimands_refused_by_name.team_volume/team_targets: ESTIMAND_UNVERIFIED: the team target definition has not been shown to match the realised aggregation and is not scored on assumption
estimands_refused_by_name.team_volume/team_rz_carries: ESTIMAND_UNVERIFIED: red-zone boundary conventions differ between the forecast and the play-by-play and have not been reconciled
estimands_refused_by_name.rushing/rushing_yards: NOT_MODELLED: RB/WR/TE rushing yards remain unavailable until RUSHING_CONVERSION_CONTROL_UNDEFINED is resolved, so there is no forecast to score
estimands_refused_by_name.receiving/receiving_td: ESTIMAND_UNVERIFIED: touchdown attribution across rushing and receiving has not been reconciled with the allocation layer
estimands_refused_by_name.rushing/rushing_td: ESTIMAND_UNVERIFIED: touchdown attribution across rushing and receiving has not been reconciled with the allocation layer

what_cannot_be_concluded: one slate is not a sample. Every figure here is descriptive and none is a test.
games are not independent observations; nothing here is clustered and no interval is quoted.
no threshold may be chosen because it would have worked today.
a forecast that was wrong today is not thereby a defect, and one that was right is not thereby correct.

carry_budget_trace.scope: the three 1 PM games with FULL non-QB board coverage and proven finality: ATL_PIT, BAL_IND, TB_CIN. Six team-games.
carry_budget_trace.reading: the team-volume layer is close (bias +1.35). The error enters BELOW it: quarterbacks are given 1.42 carries too many and the non-QB pool 4.71 too few. Projected QB + non-QB accounts for only 78% of projected team carries against 95% in reality, so roughly a fifth of the projected team carry pool is allocated to nobody on the board. That is where the carries shortfall is created.
carry_budget_trace.caveat: six team-games, one slate, no clustering, no interval.

under_over_directional.verdict: DAL_NYG is CONSISTENT with earlier model behaviour today, not anomalous. 85.7% UNDER against 76.2% on the 4:25 slate, and the per-market ordering is nearly identical: rushing attempts about half the book, receptions about -20%, receiving yards about -8%.
under_over_directional.what_this_does_not_show: nothing here says the sportsbook is biased. Both figures are model-versus-book only; neither is scored against an outcome.

hard_rock_outcome_diagnostic.reason_1_pm: no frozen 1 PM Hard Rock snapshot exists. Only two snapshots were ever delivered: the 4:25 slate and DAL_NYG PRE. A point-in-time 1 PM capture cannot be reconstructed after the fact and must not be approximated.
hard_rock_outcome_diagnostic.reason_4_25: the 4:25 snapshot exists, but those games are not final -- postgame defers them as OUTCOME_NOT_YET_PUBLISHED.
hard_rock_outcome_diagnostic.consequence: items 6 and 7 of the request -- does a large pregame probability gap correspond to a better actual result, and what is the hit rate of UNDER versus OVER selections -- are UNANSWERED. The UNDER/OVER split above is reported without any success rate, because none can be computed.
hard_rock_outcome_diagnostic.what_would_resolve_it: a frozen Hard Rock snapshot captured before kickoff for a slate that has since gone final. The 4:25 pair becomes answerable once those games are final.

evidence_for: vs ACTUAL: rushing/carries mean signed error -2.909, 9 of 12 rows below
vs ACTUAL: PRIMARY_RUSHER tier mean signed -4.172, 5 of 6 below
vs ACTUAL: the ONLY metric with coverage BELOW nominal at both levels (50% -> 0.417, 80% -> 0.750). Every other metric is at or above nominal
vs ACTUAL: compression slope 1.338 and sd ratio 0.636, the strongest of any metric
vs BOOK: 3/3 UNDER at -50.67% on the 4:25 slate and 2/2 at -55.22% on DAL_NYG -- the same about-half-the-book signature
the carry budget trace locates it below team volume: QB +1.42, non-QB -4.71, and a fifth of the projected pool unallocated
RUSHING_ATTEMPT_LEVEL_DEFECT_SUSPECTED.why_not_stronger: 12 outcome rows and 6 primary rushers, on one slate, with no clustering and no interval. Two independent comparators agree on the direction, which is worth something, but the mechanism cannot be separated into implementation versus specification at this sample size.
RUSHING_ATTEMPT_LEVEL_DEFECT_SUSPECTED.what_would_resolve_it: score rushing/carries across a full week of completed games with date and team clustering, and instrument the allocation step to report where the unallocated fifth of the team carry pool goes. That is a measurement, not a repair.

evidence_against: vs ACTUAL the primary/depth pattern RUNS THE OTHER WAY. PRIMARY_RECEIVER mean signed +5.981 with 16 of 18 rows ABOVE actual; DEPTH_RECEIVER -2.285 with 54 of 90 below. Against the book the model was LOW on top targets and HIGH on depth players -- the opposite.
vs ACTUAL receiving_yards is near balanced: 22 below, 26 above, mean signed -2.520 on 48 rows
receiving coverage is at or ABOVE nominal at every level (0.583/0.896/0.958 for yards), which is not the signature of an over-narrow forecast
evidence_for: sd ratio model/actual is below 1 for all three receiving metrics (targets 0.925, receptions 0.774, yards 0.679), so the forecast does spread players less than outcomes did
RECEIVING_COMPRESSION_SUSPECTED.reading: the compression measured against Hard Rock is NOT reproduced against outcomes in the direction that matters. Against reality the model over-projects the top of the depth chart, not under-projects it. The suspected defect as stated -- top targets systematically under-projected -- is not corroborated.
RECEIVING_COMPRESSION_SUSPECTED.what_would_resolve_it: the same scoring across a full week, with the pregame role tier fixed as it is here, and clustered by game.

does_evidence_justify_a_new_research_can.answer: YES for the carry allocation path; NO for receiving compression.
does_evidence_justify_a_new_research_can.carry_allocation: the budget trace gives a specific, located, testable mechanism -- team volume is close, the split below it is not, and a fifth of the projected pool is unallocated. That is worth a preregistered candidate. It is NOT worth a same-day repair and none was made.
does_evidence_justify_a_new_research_can.receiving: the outcome evidence contradicts the hypothesis that motivated it. A candidate built on it now would be a candidate built to fix a pattern that reality does not show.

under_over_note_on_qb.reading: quarterback passing yards are 67 yards low on average across 16 quarterback-games, 13 of 16 below actual. This is the QB3 week-1 specification defect measured against outcomes rather than against a sportsbook, and it is consistent with the audit finding. It is held in a separate stratum and contributes to no non-QB conclusion.
